mapper.select: SELECT sn, crt_dt AS crtDt, msg_cn AS msgCn, rcptn_rgn_nm AS rcptnRgnNm, emrg_step_nm AS emrgStepNm, dst_type AS dstType FROM disaster_text_history WHERE crt_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY crt_dt DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO disaster_text_history ( sn, crt_dt, msg_cn, rcptn_rgn_nm, emrg_step_nm, dst_type, reg_ymd, mdfcn_ymd, visible_yn ) VALUES
( #{msg.sn}, #{msg.crtDt}, #{msg.msgCn}, #{msg.rcptnRgnNm}, #{msg.emrgStepNm}, #{msg.dstType}, CURDATE(), CURDATE(), 'Y' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE msg_cn = VALUES(msg_cn), rcptn_rgn_nm = VALUES(rcptn_rgn_nm), mdfcn_ymd = NOW()
